summary: OpenAI published a report describing growth of Codex usage among knowledge workers, citing user counts and usage patterns beyond software engineering.

mechanisms.reason: The report states a large, quantified increase in weekly active users and usage growth among a fast-growing non-developer segment, indicating rising aggregate inference volume.
mechanisms.quote: Codex now has more than 5 million weekly active users, up more than 6x since the launch of the desktop app in February.

mechanisms.reason: The report describes users running multiple Codex tasks in parallel to automate workflows, suggesting a shift toward agent-executed work at scale.
mechanisms.quote: users are increasingly running multiple Codex tasks in parallel, allowing them to investigate data, draft materials, and automate workflows simultaneously.

notable_reason: Quantified 6x growth in weekly active users and expansion into knowledge-work use cases is a concrete demand-side data point for inference volume trends.
